summary: The owner-required physical NTAG215 write/readback and U1 recognition gate has not yet run.
claim: Software and device instrumentation cannot establish physical RF write reliability or printer recognition.

evidence.source: The review package explicitly records physical acceptance as pending.

suggested_remediation: Write and read back real NTAG215 tags on the 2023 Razr and verify recognition on the U1 running v1.5.2-paxx12-21.
suggested_validation: Record codec, payload/message size and hash, binding position, verified readback, and U1 result without publishing tag UIDs.
